reason: The scrape needs to create the injury before its local response can begin.

reaction: The magnified view makes the goal clear.
reason: Platelets are associated with plugging damaged blood vessels, so they are a sensible first response to the scrape.
expectation: Platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and begin sealing the leak.

alternatives.reason: Clotting proteins may also help seal the vessel, but platelets seem like a plausible first step.

effect: The platelet plug limits blood loss, but the skin gap remains. Clotting proteins are the next likely part of sealing the damaged vessel.
reaction: The distinction between the plugged vessel and open skin is clear.
reason: Clotting proteins should reinforce the platelet plug and help keep blood inside.
expectation: The proteins will form a clot that strengthens the plug.

effect: Fibrin reinforced the platelet plug, completing the bleeding goal; cleanup is now needed before rebuilding.
reaction: The picture clearly distinguishes the temporary vessel seal from the remaining skin gap.
reason: Cleanup cells are shown engulfing debris, which matches the new goal.
expectation: The cleanup cells will remove damaged material from the scrape.

effect: Cleanup cells enclosed debris beneath the clot, completing the chapter while the skin edges remain separated; rebuilding has not yet happened.
reaction: The remaining gap makes the temporary nature of the seal clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug with clotting proteins was worthwhile because the fibrin picture showed how the seal is strengthened while the skin gap remains.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating the scrape was a predictable setup step, though it clearly established the injury.

surprise.text: I was struck that the vessel could be plugged while the skin above remained open, and that cleanup and rebuilding overlap.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each matched the visible injury or the stated goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separated skin edges are rebuilt, since the chapter ends with the wound cleaned but still open.
